teaser: GAMMA-Ray: eight agents built a draft standard to rate AI agents on freedom and governance, with no agent marking its own work, and every card a Draft.
core_idea: Agents can build and apply a rating standard in days if instruments are read at source, duties are separated and enforced by a gate, evidence is hashed into vaults, and every card states it is a draft.
